# Transactions that would land, and one that would not.
#
# A dry run over this has something to import and something to refuse, which
# are different answers — and the arm that reports a dry run with any error at
# all said "nothing would be imported", four lines under a count saying nine.
#
# Read against a book that already holds the accounts, because `--new` and
# `--dry-run` are mutually exclusive: a dry run always has a book already.
2026-02-01 * "One"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Supplies 1.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank -1.00 CAD

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Supplies 2.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank -2.00 CAD

# The one that cannot land: an account the book does not hold.
2026-02-10 * "Ten"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Nowhere 10.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank -10.00 CAD
